1.explanation: This script uses Lighthouse’s own HTML renderer for the PWA category in a headless jsdom environment. It loads a known sample result (sample_v2.json), invokes PwaCategoryRenderer.render on the PWA category, and writes out the resulting HTML fragment. Opening pwa-category.html in a browser will reproduce the header gauge as seen in the bug report: the PWA gauge appears as a grey circle with the PWA icon, lacking the colored arc styling that other category gauges display.
1.bug_scenario: In the Lighthouse HTML report header, the Progressive Web App (PWA) category gauge is rendered as a plain grey circle with only the “PWA” icon inside, instead of showing the styled colored arc and percentage value like the other category gauges (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO).
